source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of file modes (PDF 62-63).

blocks.text: File modes batate hain ke file par kaunsa kaam ho sakta hai: parhna, likhna ya aakhir mein jorna.

items: Read ("r"): sirf parhne ke liye. File pehle se maujood honi chahiye.
Write ("w"): sirf likhne ke liye. File pehle se ho to us ka content mita deta hai (truncate, yani khaali kar deta hai); na ho to nayi file bana deta hai.
Append ("a"): aakhir mein jorne ke liye. Likha gaya data file ke aakhir mein jurta hai.
Read and Write ("r+"): parhna aur likhna dono. File pehle se maujood honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Purane scores khoye baghair scores file ke aakhir mein naya score jorne ke liye kaunsa mode?

blocks.text: scores.txt mein pehle se do scores hain. mode ko "w" aur phir "a" kar ke Run karein aur dekhein purane scores rehte hain ya mit jate hain; new_score bhi badal sakte hain.

mode = "w"
new_score = 90
with open("scores.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("75\n80\n")    # purane scores
with open("scores.txt", mode) as file:
    file.write(str(new_score) + "\n")
with open("scores.txt", "r") as file:
    print("File mein ab yeh hai:")
    print(file.read())

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"mode = "w"" aur "new_score = 90": file kholne ka mode aur naya score.
"with open("scores.txt", "w") as file:" aur "file.write("75\n80\n")": file mein do purane scores 75 aur 80 likhe jate hain (comment bhi yahi kehta hai).
"with open("scores.txt", mode) as file:": file mode variable ke hisaab se khulti hai; "w" purana sab mita deta hai.
"file.write(str(new_score) + "\n")": str() number ko text banata hai kyunke write() sirf text likhta hai.
"with open("scores.txt", "r") as file:": file parh kar heading aur poora text print hota hai.
Output: "File mein ab yeh hai:" aur phir sirf "90" (aur ek khaali line), kyunke "w" mode ne 75 aur 80 mita diye.
Khud try karein: mode = "a" kar ke Run karein: ab 75, 80 aur 90 teeno lines aayengi, kyunke "a" purana data rakh kar naya aakhir mein jorta hai.

items: r parhna, w mita kar likhna, a aakhir mein jorna, r+ dono.
